review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–174). It has no @[simp] attributes and no custom simp lemmas. The only simp call is `by simp` in `coverCostarEquiv`, where it proves `(of e)⁻¹ • x.back` goes to `of e • _ = x.back`. That relies on existing Mathlib simp lemmas. I searched the repo for uses of coverProjection, coverStarEquiv, coverCostarEquiv and freeActionGroupoidIsFree. None of them is used outside this file. Other Kurosh files use only `coverQuiver`, `CoverVertex` and the `Quiver.Hom` subtype, in explicit `@Quiver.Hom` signatures. I found no downstream simp-normal-form problem, competing rule, loop or unwanted expansion. `coverProjection` could take `@[simps]`, and the Subtype `Hom` could get projection lemmas. But the in-file proofs close those goals with `rfl`, and nothing else uses them, so I could not justify a simp recommendation. I did not run Lean, so I can't rule out simp issues that only show up there.
